description: Hybrid Vehicle Fuel Efficiency is a dataset listed in Cary, NC Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Cary. This dataset contains the average monthly fuel efficiency (miles per gallon) for Cary's hybrid vehicles. Coverage: Cary, North Carolina. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are Fuel Economy, Fuel Efficiency, MPG. The portal shows 119 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-townofcary-org-portal.
